verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents OpenAI API compatibility. Existing apps switch by changing only the API key, base URL, and model ID, which is configuration rather than provider-specific code [cerebras-docs-3][cerebras-docs-4]. The docs also cover the standard image_url content shape, streaming, tool calling, and structured outputs [cerebras-docs-15][cerebras-docs-5][cerebras-docs-7][cerebras-docs-6]. Community reports add some caution: a 422 wrong_api_format error when integrating via claude-code-router, and earlier 'patchy' Cursor integration that has since gained official support [cerebras-comm-11][cerebras-comm-12]. Missing for 10: no documented list of unsupported or divergent OpenAI parameters, independent hands-on confirmation of drop-in switching mid-workflow, and resolution of the reported format-compatibility errors.
